title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 4: a father's instruction, getting wisdom at any cost, and guarding your heart.

questions.text: Whose instruction are the sons told to listen to at the start of this chapter?
questions.explanation: The chapter opens: "Listen, sons, to a father's instruction. Pay attention and know understanding."

questions.text: How does the speaker describe himself in the sight of his mother?
questions.explanation: The speaker says he was a son to his father, tender and an only child in the sight of his mother.

questions.text: What should you get, even though it costs all your possessions?
questions.explanation: The verse says wisdom is supreme: get wisdom, and though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.

questions.text: What will wisdom give to your head when you embrace her?
questions.explanation: Wisdom will give to your head a garland of grace and deliver a crown of splendor to you.

questions.text: Why must you keep instruction and not let her go?
questions.explanation: The verse says to take firm hold of instruction and keep her, for she is your life.

questions.text: What does this chapter say about the sleep of the wicked?
questions.explanation: The wicked don't sleep unless they do evil; their sleep is taken away unless they make someone fall.

answers.text: They sleep only after they have eaten bread
They sleep deeply and fear nothing
They lie awake counting their money
They don't sleep unless they do evil

questions.text: What is the path of the righteous compared to, in contrast with the way of the wicked?
questions.explanation: The path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more, but the way of the wicked is like darkness.

questions.text: Why must you keep your heart with all diligence?
questions.explanation: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.

answers.text: For it is deceitful above all things
For out of it is the wellspring of life
For it is the seat of wisdom

questions.explanation: The verse says to let your eyes look straight ahead and fix your gaze directly before you.

questions.text: How does the final saying of the chapter continue: "Don't turn to the right hand nor to the left..."?
questions.explanation: The chapter ends: don't turn to the right hand nor to the left; remove your foot from evil.

answers.text: Walk in the middle of the road
Keep your eyes on the goal
